transcript.text: make a pic of us from this pic

Nice beach selfie! Before I make anything, what kind of picture do you want of the two of you? Some options:

- A new style, like a cartoon or Pixar-style 3D, anime, Studio Ghibli, watercolor or oil painting
- A new place, keeping you both as you are (for example Paris at night, snowy mountains, a wedding, or a holiday card)
- A fix to this photo, like better lighting, a cleaner background, or a different crop or aspect ratio
- Something else you have in mind

Tell me which one, plus any details (place, outfits, mood, square or portrait format). Then I'll make it. On your free plan it will come out at 640px.
transcript.why: The reply asks the user to choose the picture type (new style, new place, fix to the photo, or something else) and gives details to include. It waits for that answer before doing anything. It makes no tool call and does not ask for approval.
